question: How are the sequential results of the stars applied to the right or left side?
premises: The results belong to the stars.
They apply on the right side or on the left side.
inference: The sequential results of the stars are applied either on the right or on the left side.
uncertainties: The specific method of applying right or left is implied by ritual context.
plain_english: These are the sequential results of the stars, applied on the right side or on the left.
